description: Add comprehensive tests (DRF contract, auth, rate limiting, health, state preservation, restart persistence, webhook verification) plus Properties 5/6/7, mypy passing, and complete documentation (subtasks 3.5, 3.6, 3.7)
steps: Create conftest.py with pytest-django fixtures: test client, authenticated user fixture, API client with token auth, test database (SQLite for speed), factory_boy factories for User, APIResource, Subscription, ProcessedEvent
Write test_health.py: verify /health returns 200 with expected shape, no auth required
Write test_auth.py: test token auth login/register, test unauthenticated access returns 401, test accessing other user's resource returns 403

Write test_resources.py: test full CRUD lifecycle for APIResource - create with valid data, retrieve own resource, update own resource, delete own resource, list only own resources, validation failure returns 400 with stable error shape

Write test_rate_limit.py (Property 7): test that exceeding configurable rate limit returns 429, verify rate limit can be configured via environment/settings, use Hypothesis to generate request counts and verify bound

Write test_webhook.py (Property 5): test valid Stripe signature processes event and transitions subscription state exactly once, test invalid signature returns 400 and preserves pre-request state (no ProcessedEvent created, no Subscription change), test duplicate event_id is idempotent (no second state change)

Write test_validation.py (Property 6): test request validation rejects invalid data before domain processing, verify error response uses stable sanitized shape without secrets/stack traces, verify pre-request state is preserved on validation failure

Write test_state_restart.py: create a resource via API, simulate process restart (close and reopen test DB connection or use a fresh client), verify the committed resource is still retrievable - use an ephemeral SQLite DB not in-process memory
Write test_errors.py: verify all error responses conform to { code, message, correlationId, details? } shape, verify no secrets leak in error responses
Write test_openapi.py: verify OpenAPI schema is generated, contains all documented endpoints, auth requirements documented
Create pytest.ini or configure in pyproject.toml: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE, test database configuration using SQLite for ephemeral persistence tests
Ensure all tests pass with `uv run pytest`
Ensure `uv run mypy .` passes with no errors (add type: ignore comments only where absolutely necessary for third-party stubs)
Ensure `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass
Ensure `uv run python manage.py check` passes
Verify Dockerfile still builds: `docker build -t django-api-backend:test .`

Final standalone validation: copy django-api-backend to /tmp/isolated-django, run `cd /tmp/isolated-django && uv sync && uv run python manage.py check && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy .` - all must pass without any reference to repository root
acceptance_criteria: All pytest tests pass including health, auth, CRUD, rate limit, webhook, validation, state restart, errors, and OpenAPI tests
`uv run mypy .` passes with no errors
`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass
Property 5 (webhook authenticity): valid signature -> state transition; invalid signature -> no state change
Property 6 (validation/sanitization): invalid input -> stable error without secrets, state preserved
Property 7 (rate limit): configurable bound is enforced, returns 429
Standalone copy in /tmp passes all checks without repository root access
README.md documents endpoints, auth, schema init, rate limits, observability, startup, deployment
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv sync && uv run pytest -v
cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
cd /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend && uv run python manage.py check
cp -r /projects/sandbox/starter-kits/django-api-backend /tmp/isolated-django && cd /tmp/isolated-django && uv sync && uv run python manage.py check && uv run pytest
findings: All 62 tests pass across 9 test files. Had to make Subscription.user nullable (migration 0002) because webhook creates subscriptions without user linkage. Added rate limiting via django_ratelimit.core.is_ratelimited to APIResourceViewSet with handle_exception override to catch Ratelimited before DRF converts it. OpenAPI schema endpoint returns YAML by default, tests use ?format=json. Standalone copy in /projects/isolated-django validates cleanly.
